_doc: clinic-manual-tax — what the SAME booking costs a keyboard/switch user by hand.
Every input here is a browser-trusted event dispatched through CDP; the page's own counter
(interaction-counter.ts) counts only trusted events, so this number is measured, never scripted.
It stops at the review step and asserts >= 30: Chrome's native date picker does not accept
segment entry through CDP dispatchKeyEvent (a real keyboard fills it fine), so the run cannot
complete the booking headlessly. The number is therefore a FLOOR, not the total — the complete
hand-vs-agent comparison is the page's own receipt, shown live in the product.
Compare with clinic-thesis.json, where the agent path costs the person 1 trusted input.

eval: (() => { const n = Number(document.querySelector('[data-clinic-counter]')?.getAttribute('data-clinic-counter') ?? -1); window.__hand = n - window.__t0; return window.__hand; })()
